description.value: Taseko Adventures is a remote wilderness lodge and resort on Taseko Lake in British Columbia's Chilcotin region, reachable by 3+ hours of off-road travel or floatplane transfer from Whistler. Guests stay in deluxe log cabins and can choose between fully guided all-inclusive wilderness packages or self-contained cabin rentals, with activities ranging from jet boat excursions to guided hunting. The lodge emphasizes rustic authenticity, organic cuisine, and a wood-fired sauna and hot tub in an untouched backcountry setting.

address.value: PO Box 4232 Williams Lake, BC V2G 2V3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and provides rich detail about Taseko Adventures as a remote wilderness resort on Taseko Lake in the Chilcotin region, accessible by 3+ hours of off-road driving or floatplane. No cycling-specific content appears anywhere on the site — no bike storage, laundry, e-bike charging, tools, or any related amenities are mentioned — so all bike-related criteria must be null. The phone number on the website footer ((250) 307-3627) matches the OSM value; however, the email on the website (info@tasekooutfitters.com) differs from the OSM email (info@tasekolakeoutfitters.com), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Email mismatch: OSM lists info@tasekolakeoutfitters.com but the website footer shows info@tasekooutfitters.com — the OSM email may be outdated.
No physical civic address is available; OSM has no address and the website only provides a PO Box (Williams Lake) as a mailing address.
The resort is extremely remote (3+ hours off-road or by floatplane), which may limit practical accessibility for most touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Taseko Adventures is a real, operating wilderness resort with active bookings and a functioning website. It is a legitimate accommodation option for touring cyclists venturing into the Chilcotin backcountry.
enrichment_extras.notes: The rates page notes that explorer cabin rentals include kitchenettes and guests bring their own food; all-inclusive packages include all meals. Horse activities are suspended for 2026 and return in 2027. Guided wilderness bookings are open for summer 2027.
